original.text: ㅇ 대학원 논문제출자격시험: 석박사통합과정 재응시 관련
석박사통합과정 입학생은 박사과정 논문제출자격시험을 반드시 입학 후 셋째 학기 초에 응시하여야 하며, 응시횟수는 1회로 제한한다.
단, 불합격자에 대해 지도교수가 청원서를 제출하여 학사위원회의 심의를 거쳐 승인되면
그 다음 학기에 한번의 기회를 더 부여할 수 있다.
석박사통합과정 입학생은 입학 후 셋째 학기 초에 박사과정 논문제출자격시험에 응시하여 합격하여야 한다.
불합격 시, 지도교수가 학생의 우수성을 입증하는 청원서를 해당학기에 학사위원회에 제출하여 심의를 통과하는 것을 전제로,
최대 2회의 다음 학기 재응시가 가능하나, 심의에서 한번이라도 거절된 경우에는 재응시가 불가하다.

english: This notice explains the internal graduate school regulations of the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering.
Decision of the department faculty meeting on 23 Sep 2024 (Mon)
ㅇ Graduate 논문제출자격시험 (thesis qualifying exam): retaking the exam in the 석박사통합과정 (integrated master's–doctoral program)

Students admitted to the integrated master's–doctoral program must take the doctoral thesis qualifying exam at the beginning of their third semester after admission, and they may take the exam only once.
However, if a student fails, the academic advisor may submit a petition, and if the petition is reviewed and approved by the 학사위원회 (Academic Affairs Committee),
the student may be given one more chance in the following semester.
Students admitted to the integrated master's–doctoral program must take and pass the doctoral thesis qualifying exam at the beginning of their third semester after admission.
If a student fails, the academic advisor must submit a petition proving the student's excellence to the Academic Affairs Committee in that semester, and the petition must pass the committee's review.
On this condition, the student may retake the exam in a following semester up to 2 times. However, if a petition is rejected in the review even once, the student cannot retake the exam.
This applies from the 2nd semester of the 2024 academic year (exam held in Sep 2024).
